changelog: `apm install --frozen` replays a lockfile written through `PROXY_REGISTRY_URL` for tag and branch refs, verifying the proxy route, ref and locked content hash (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: A lockfile written through the registry proxy records the proxy route and archive content hash but no commit, so install --frozen refused it as having no verifiable commit for any non-semver tag or branch ref.

notes: Recording was already sufficient: the proxy lock row carries host, registry_prefix, resolved_ref and content_hash. A commit-less row is accepted only when the current routing lands on the same proxy route, the ref is unchanged and a content hash is locked; materialization then enforces the content hash (tamper test: changed archive -> exit 1 'Content hash mismatch', lock and deployed bytes unchanged). The tamper test runs with policy ON; the pre-existing parametrized replay test keeps its --no-policy. Not fixed (outside the scope line): the unprefixed 'cache-pin:' warning line on the first proxy install mentioned in the issue body. Flips E03 s5 e03-frozen-refuses-proxy-lockfile (PR #4156).
